cases.name: Gail F. Shollar
cases.narrative:
On 11/7/1992, her partially nude body was found under leaves in a drainage ditch at the Stelton Lumber Company Yard. She had more than 40 stab wounds on her chest, forearm, neck and face. She had a slash wound on her throat with an inch and a half gape down to her spinal cord.

She was one of the first people in NJ to be a victim of carjacking. She was loading groceries into her minivan at the Pathmark Supermarket in the Middlesex County Mall when he approached her and forced her into her vehicle at knife point.
